mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_tax_transaction (id, calculation_id, source_system, source_fact_type, source_fact_id, tax_scope_key, origin, transaction_kind, tax_subject_party_id, currency, occurred_at, tax_point_date, tax_point_basis, registered_at, reporting_status, reporting_block_reason, source_payload_hash, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{row.id}, #{row.calculationId}, #{row.sourceSystem}, #{row.sourceFactType}, #{row.sourceFactId}, #{row.taxScopeKey}, #{row.origin}, #{row.transactionKind}, #{row.taxSubjectPartyId}, #{row.currency}, #{row.occurredAt}, #{row.taxPointDate}, #{row.taxPointBasis}, #{row.registeredAt}, #{row.reportingStatus}, #{row.reportingBlockReason}, #{row.sourcePayloadHash}, #{row.createTime}, #{row.updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, calculation_id, source_system, source_fact_type, source_fact_id, tax_scope_key, origin, transaction_kind, tax_subject_party_id, currency, occurred_at, tax_point_date, tax_point_basis, registered_at, reporting_status, reporting_block_reason, source_payload_hash, create_time, update_time FROM t_tax_transaction WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, calculation_id, source_system, source_fact_type, source_fact_id, tax_scope_key, origin, transaction_kind, tax_subject_party_id, currency, occurred_at, tax_point_date, tax_point_basis, registered_at, reporting_status, reporting_block_reason, source_payload_hash, create_time, update_time FROM t_tax_transaction WHERE calculation_id IN #{v} ORDER BY id
